strongest_angle: Major entertainment unions, including SAG-AFTRA, the WGA, and the AFM, have filed a 34-page legal brief urging a federal judge to reject a fair use exemption for OpenAI, citing systemic harms to creative professionals.

key_facts.fact: SAG-AFTRA, the American Federation of Musicians, and the Writers Guild of America East and West filed a joint amicus brief in the OpenAI copyright litigation.
The legal brief filed by the labor unions against OpenAI consists of 34 pages of arguments regarding fair use exemptions.
The Wikimedia Foundation also filed a separate amicus brief challenging the fair use claims made by AI companies including OpenAI, Microsoft, and Anthropic.

numbers.label: Page count of the union amicus brief

quotes.text: The harms of unlicensed training fall not just on companies like the News Plaintiffs, but on the countless professionals behind the work
quotes.speaker: The amicus brief
